maddeler.e:
يحتجم (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِمُ (yaḥtajimu) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# يُحْتَجَمُ (yuḥtajamu) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# يَحْتَجِمَ (yaḥtajima) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
